samples.summary: Docs table-cell background "Reset" still writes the legacy empty string, bypassing the new `undefined`-clears convention
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-table-context-menu.tsx:230 — `editor.applyTableCellStyle({ backgroundColor: "" })`. The change switched both text/highlight resets to `undefined` (text-format-group.tsx:252/347, docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:490/512) precisely because `""` is stored as a real attribute rather than removed (yorkie-doc-store.ts:144-163 only removes keys explicitly set to `undefined`). This cell-background reset was left on the old form, so it persists `backgroundColor: ""` in the CRDT. Rendering happens to survive it (table-renderer.ts:175-176 guards on truthiness) and DOCX export now silently drops it (docx-exporter.ts:319), but the stored data stays in the invalid legacy shape the change is trying to retire.

samples.summary: PDF export sink was not routed through the new shared color normalizer, so pasted `rgb()` colors export as black (including black background rectangles)
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/export/pdf-style-map.ts:143-153 `styleColor()` still accepts only `#RRGGBB` and returns `{r:0,g:0,b:0}` for anything else. Its callers pdf-painter.ts:706 (run text color) and pdf-painter.ts:758-759 / pdf-table-painter.ts:178 (run + cell background fill) therefore paint HTML-pasted `rgb(255, 0, 0)` (the exact untrusted shape the diff's own comments cite as routine, from view/clipboard.ts:150-154) as black — and a black *filled rectangle* behind the text for backgrounds. The change centralizes normalization for the DOCX (`toDocxHexColor`) and PPTX (`storedColorToThemeColor`) sinks and exports `toRgbHexColor` for exactly this purpose, but the third export sink of the same values was not updated.

samples.summary: Sheets formatting toolbar still uses the `""`-means-reset pattern the change is retiring
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/components/formatting-toolbar.tsx:200 (`spreadsheet?.applyStyle({ tc: "" })`) and :213 (`{ bg: "" }`). This is the sheets style model, not docs `InlineStyle`, so it is not broken by the diff — but it is the same empty-string-as-reset pattern that #728 shows is fragile when the value reaches `ctx.fillStyle` or an OOXML attribute. Worth confirming the sheets renderer/exporters treat `""` as unset rather than assigning it.

samples.summary: Node-safe PPTX exporter gains a new runtime (value) import of the docs browser entry
samples.evidence: packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:3 `import { toRgbHexColor } from '@wafflebase/docs'` — previously this module imported only types from docs, so `@wafflebase/slides/node` → `exportPptx` (packages/slides/src/node.ts:171, consumed by packages/cli/src/slides/pptx-export.ts:1) had no runtime edge into the docs *root* (browser) entry from the export path. The added node re-export (`packages/docs/src/node.ts:100`) is only reached through backend's tsconfig paths mapping, not by this import specifier. This appears already precedented — packages/slides/src/import/pptx/text.ts:2 and model/layout.ts value-import the same root entry and are also re-exported from slides' node entry — so it is likely harmless, but if the docs root entry ever gains module-load DOM access the CLI PPTX export path now depends on it too.
